title: Kissed Tunisian Soybean Wrap
description: A silky, fatty yet low-calorie wrap that blends soybean sprouts with savory Tunisian spices, wrapped in a steamed leaf for a cozy, satisfying meal.
instructions: Rinse soybean sprouts and kongnamul thoroughly and drain them.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and sauté the sprouts for 3 minutes.
Add harissa paste to the pan, stir until the sprouts are coated, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Remove the pan from heat, stir in lime juice, cilantro, salt, and pepper, and let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Steam the leaf wraps for 30 seconds until pliable, then lay them flat on a clean surface.
Spoon an even amount of the soybean mixture onto each wrap and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
Fold the sides of the wrap over the filling and roll tightly, securing with a toothpick if desired.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 4 hours before serving cold.
